verdicts.reason: All rules hold: the done-when is a quote with a source-file or Figma-variable locator plus a raw-hex/px fail, reliable is earned because the claim requires reading the source file, an empty token set passes as "absent", and checkRunnable false is honest.

A3 fails: the done-when never checks the brief's "keep the list shorter than the system" rule (for example with a count of bans against a count of system rules), so a pytest exit 0 can pass an oversized list.

A3 fails: the done-when checks unlisted count and records each component, but nothing enforces the brief's "same prompt, same component" rule (no repeat-run comparison of the recorded component lines).

A3 fails: the done-when says spacing and type are "taken from tokens" but names no check for it, since a pixel diff against the template does not prove token provenance, and the one-page-type rule sits only in the trigger.

All rules hold: exit code plus a printed failed-rule id with no near-pass, assisted does not exceed the brief's tool-dependent ceiling, an absent CLI is a valid not-runnable result, and checkRunnable false is honest.
